title: Action de Galois sur Teichmüller : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: this is part of Grothendieck's set-up for computing the action of Gal(Q̄/Q), or GT-type automorphisms, on the Teichmüller groupoid in low dimension. A surface Σ̃ carries a cell/graph structure: vertices P_ε, Q_i and further points R_i^ω, S_i^ε, with arcs a_i^ω, c_i^ε, d_i^ε. The fundamental groups at the various vertices have to be 'pinned' (épinglés) to standard groups.

Formula (31) names the comparison isomorphisms. φ_{R_i^ω,ωi}: Π_{ωi} ≅ π_1(Σ̃, R_i^ω), abbreviated φ_{ωi} or written c_{ωi}^ω (it is induced by a path). Similarly φ_{S_i^ε,ω}: Π_ω ≅ π_1(Σ̃, S_i^ε), abbreviated φ_ω or d_i^ε. Grothendieck then decides to write just φ_i, φ_ε, since the base point (R_i or S_i) is clear from the computation.

A crossed-out passage proposed splitting each arc a_i^ω into two halves through the midpoint S_i^ω:
- a_i^{ω+}: R_i^ω → S_i^ω,
- a_i^{ω-}: S_i^ω → R_i^{ω'}.

For formal computations all Π_i, Π_ω are to be identified with one standard group (32): π_{0,3} = π_1(P^1_C∖{0,1,∞}, P^+) = ⟨l_0, l_1, l_∞ | l_∞ l_1 l_0 = 1⟩, free of rank 2. It sits inside π̃_{0,3}, the orbifold fundamental group of the quotient of M_{0,3}(C) by S_3 × {1,T}, where T is complex conjugation. P^+ is presumably a point such as e^{iπ/3}, whose stabiliser in S_3 × {1,T} is a twisted copy of S_3 (order 6). Its presentation is ⟨ρ, σ_∞, σ̃_∞ | ρ^3 = σ_∞^2 = σ̃_∞^2 = 1, σ̃_∞ρσ̃_∞^{-1} = ρ^{-1}, σ̃_∞σ_∞σ̃_∞^{-1} = σ_∞ (i.e. (σ̃_∞σ_∞)^2 = 1)⟩. A first attempt '⟨ρ,σ | ρ^3 = σ^2 = 1⟩ ≅ SL(2,Z)/±1' (the holomorphic part only) is crossed out and replaced by ≅ GL(2,Z)/±1 = PGL(2,Z).

This is the standard presentation of the extended modular group as an amalgam D_2 *_{Z/2} D_3 (generated by the involution σ̃ together with σ, resp. ρ). π_{0,3} corresponds to the image of Γ(2), of index 12 = |S_3 × Z/2|. The next page derives the standard 'formulaire': ε_i, l_i = ε_i^2, the cyclic action of ρ, and τ_∞ = σ_∞σ̃_∞. These feed into the épinglage isomorphisms ψ: Π_{0,3} ≅ Π_ε, Π_i indexed by r = (i, ω, ϖ).
errors: Notational inconsistency: the next page writes Π̃_{0,3} ≃ Sl(2,Z), whereas this page (after correction) correctly gives GL(2,Z)/±1. The holomorphic part ⟨ρ,σ_∞⟩ is PSL(2,Z), not SL(2,Z).
The relation written 'σ̃_∞(σ_∞) = 1' must mean σ̃_∞(σ_∞) = σ_∞ (conjugation fixes σ_∞), which is equivalent to (σ̃_∞σ_∞)^2 = 1 as stated. Taken literally, '= 1' is a slip.
In (31) the subscript of the second map is unclear (ω* / ωε). The source group is written Π_ω while the base point is S_i^ε; this is possibly a slip for Π_ε, though the image seems to read Π_ω.

ideas.what: Systematic pinning of fundamental groups at several base points (vertices of a cell structure) via chosen paths, giving comparison isomorphisms between π_1's at different base points.
ideas.modern_name: fundamental groupoid with a chosen set of base points / tangential base points; rigidification of the Teichmüller groupoid
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (Esquisse d'un programme, 1984); developed by Drinfeld, Ihara, Lochak–Schneps, Nakamura
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (fundamental groupoids with several base points, Teichmüller tower)

ideas.what: Standard group π_{0,3} = π_1(P^1∖{0,1,∞}) with generators l_0, l_1, l_∞ and l_∞l_1l_0 = 1, embedded in the orbifold π_1 of M_{0,3}/(S_3 × complex conjugation).
ideas.modern_name: extended modular group PGL(2,Z) ≅ D_2 *_{Z/2} D_3, containing Γ(2)/±1 ≅ F_2 with index 12
ideas.usually_credited_to: classical (Klein, Fricke); in the Galois–Teichmüller context Ihara, Drinfeld (the 2- and 3-cycle relations of GT)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse mentions SL(2,Z) and the S_3-symmetry of M_{0,4}; the explicit real/PGL(2,Z) version is not known to me in his published texts

deep.surprise_reason: Bookkeeping page: notation for base-point comparison isomorphisms and the classical presentation of PGL(2,Z) as the S_3 × Gal(C/R)-equivariant orbifold π_1 of M_{0,3}. Including complex conjugation is a nice touch, but the result is standard and implicit in later GT literature.
transcription_corrections: 'On plus commodes [-une-] ensemble des notes [?] simplement' likely reads 'Il sera plus commode dans l'ensemble des notes [de noter] simplement'.
'qui sont des jours [?]' should probably be 'qui sont donnés'.
'ne laissant pas de doute' is more likely 'ne faisant pas de doute'.
Crossed-out passage: 'Les arcs a_i^ω se dédoublent [?] trop longs' more likely reads 'Les arcs a_i^ω étant légèrement trop longs, il faut les couper en deux en posant'.
In (32), '=σ̃_∞^2' is an insertion above the line, giving ρ^3 = σ_∞^2 = σ̃_∞^2 = 1.
The final crossed-out group '{ρ,…| ρ^3 = σ_∞^2 = 1} ≃ SL(2,Z)/±1' is replaced by '≃ GL(2,Z)/±1'.
The underbrace annotation S_3 × {1,T} labels the quotient group acting on M_{0,3}(C), i.e. the base point is taken in the quotient by S_3 × {1,T}.
